content.title: 表语从句·连接词 what / that / why / where / how / when / because / whether 速查
content.intro: 系动词(be/seem/look 等)后面、用来说明主语「是什么」的从句叫表语从句。判断口诀:从句缺主语/宾语 → 用 what;从句完整、只起连接 → 用 that;从句缺状语 → 按意义选 why/where/how/when;表是非选择 → whether。

rows: 从句缺主语或宾语:This is what makes them special.(缺主语)
从句完整、不缺成分:The truth is that he never gave up.
从句缺原因状语:That is why he is admired.
从句缺地点状语:A small shop was where he ate every day.
从句缺方式状语:Practice is how he mastered the craft.
从句缺时间状语:Dawn was when the light was best.
「This is ____」后接原因从句:This is because he refused all gifts.
表是非选择:The question is whether the clock can be fixed.

specialRules.rule: 「The reason … is ____」后只能用 that,绝不能用 because
specialRules.mark: The reason is that …(√) / The reason is because …(×)

specialRules.rule: what 在从句里要充当成分(主语或宾语);that 在从句里不作任何成分
specialRules.mark: what makes …(what=主语) / that he won(that 不作成分)

specialRules.rule: 「This is because …」表原因;「This is why …」表结果,方向相反别混
specialRules.mark: 病了→This is why he didn't come;没来→This is because he was ill

specialRules.rule: 表语从句表「是否」用 whether,不用 if
specialRules.mark: The point is whether …(√) / is if …(×)

why: 表语从句就是把一个句子整体放在 be 之后当「表语」。连接词的选择只看一件事:这个从句里缺什么——缺主/宾用 what,缺状语按意义用 why/where/how/when,什么都不缺就用 that。
gaokaoPoints: what 与 that 的辨析(从句是否缺主语/宾语)是语法填空与改错的高频考点。
「the reason … is that(not because)」是经典送分陷阱,务必记牢。
why/where/how/when 引导表语从句时,前面不加 the(That is why,不是 That is the why)。

examVsReal.exam: The reason he is respected is that he is modest.(考试)
examVsReal.note: 考试用表语从句 that;日常口语直接用 because 引出原因状语从句更自然。

examVsReal.exam: This is what makes them so special.(考试)
examVsReal.real: That's the special thing about them.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考 what 引导的表语从句;口语常换成名词短语,显得更轻松。
